verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: the Insights dashboards (docs-54) are described as reviews of experiment impact and metric correlations, with nothing stating the content is AI-generated. The AI Visual Editor is for building variations, not analyzing data, and the MCP server connects external AI tools rather than producing insights inside GrowthBook.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
